all_loaded_roi_scope: Every roi_heads.* state tensor except running_mean, running_var and num_batches_tracked. This includes the descriptor and training identity classifier, not just the online transformer.
count_method: torch.load(weights_only=True, mmap=True, map_location=cpu); sum numel with module-prefix and buffer filters; no forward or GPU work
note: Pretrained native association model size is separate from the count of parameters optimized during the current research experiment. A raw state-dict tensor-element sum includes buffers and must not be reported as the model parameter count.
